About 5% — dashboards are mostly for finance reporting
50% — dashboards automatically resize instances
10% — but only on Azure

$700.80 — instance plus Multi-AZ

questions.explain: The DetectCostAnomalies procedure compares yesterday's cost against a 14-day rolling mean/stddev baseline; z-scores of 2.0/3.0/4.0 map to medium/high/critical severity, and critical anomalies page on-call within 5 minutes.
options: Fixed dollar thresholds set manually per database
Week-over-week percentage change greater than 15%
A 30-day moving median with no severity tiers
14-day rolling mean/stddev z-scores: 2.0 = medium, 3.0 = high, 4.0 = critical
